provenance.source_priority: 523 source definitions > confirmed official information > explicit local estimate
provenance.search_result: Official Totem guide confirms poison and shield effects, but supplies no poison tick or shield capacity. Existing research identifies the same missing definitions.
provenance.shield_capacity: Local estimate uses only the existing Guardian host skill's base capacity of 100; its SP scaling is not copied. Capacity is capped at the host player's maximum HP.
provenance.venom_interval: Local estimate reuses the existing Monster.apply_poison host default of one second. This is not evidence of the native server interval.
provenance.venom_formula: Local adapter snapshots floor(target maximum HP * source PoisonDamageByMaxHP / 1000000), clamped to source MinPoisonDamage and MaxPoisonDamage, once per tick. First tick follows one full interval; no tick after the source-duration boundary.
provenance.venom_ownership: One snapshot per totem origin. Reapplication replaces the snapshot. Regular poison remains independent; host poison immunity is respected; host cleanse removes the poison component only.
provenance.shield_lifetime: Existing local source-duration policy: five seconds; confirmed DR remains until expiry even if absorption is exhausted. Refresh replaces capacity instead of adding stacks.
provenance.shield_order: After existing host skill shields and the confirmed Totem DR on the triggering hit. Absorbed damage may be zero. No cooldown reset on settings changes.
provenance.settings: Validated settings are saved atomically with the host save. They apply to subsequent procs; active snapshots keep their existing values. Source tables and source probabilities are never changed.
